instruction: Extract a frame from the playing video and save it as an image file named 'video_snapshot.png' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting a video frame and saving it as a PNG image. Evaluator validates: (1) file is a valid PNG by checking magic bytes and opening with PIL, (2) file size is reasonable (50KB-2MB) for a video screenshot, (3) image dimensions are at least 640x480 pixels, typical for video frames. This ensures the file is not just renamed but an actual valid image with video-appropriate dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Strong PNG validation: Getter checks PNG magic bytes (89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A) and successfully opens with PIL.Image - ensures file is a valid PNG, not just renamed
Appropriate size validation: 50KB-2MB range is reasonable for video screenshots across different resolutions
Sensible dimension validation: 640x480 minimum covers standard video resolutions (SD, HD, Full HD)
Robust error handling: Returns None for missing files, handles PIL exceptions for corrupted images
Complete verifiable coverage: Checks all aspects that can be verified without a reference image (format, size, dimensions)

Limitation (unavoidable without reference): Cannot verify image was extracted from the specific video vs. being any valid PNG with correct dimensions - but this is inherent to the task without a gold reference frame
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Current implementation is strong for practical verification
Optional enhancement: Could add PNG metadata checks (creation timestamp, software used)
Optional enhancement: Could check pixel data statistics (not all black/white, has color variation)
Note: Verifying the image is actually from the video would require either: (1) reference frame comparison, or (2) video analysis to extract expected frame - both beyond practical scope
